summary: CoreCivic filed an 8-K reporting its election to redeem its outstanding 4.750% senior notes due 2027 (originally $250M, with $238.468M outstanding as of July 13, 2026). The redemption occurs on August 12, 2026, at par plus a make-whole premium and accrued interest, funded from cash on hand. This is a routine debt refinancing / liability management action, not a special-situation event. No shareholder vote, premium to market, or structural complexity beyond standard note-redemption mechanics. Watch: no risk-arb angle; the filing is purely administrative.
